assets.content:
LAYOUT SPEC for Sable & Finch's own existing printed open-house card, supplied as the template for the twelve-listing run (flat single record, to be converted and reverse-engineered downstream).

Document: single card, 178 x 127 mm LANDSCAPE (7 x 5 in), NO bleed box present (trim = media box, 0 mm bleed), fonts embedded. This is last season's card as the label/print shop supplied it.

WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE PRINTED (four apparent blocks):
- Top-left: the SABLE & FINCH lockup in small caps with an OPEN HOUSE kicker above it.
- Left column, large: the ADDRESS in a warm text serif, with the TOWN in smaller caps beneath.
- Middle band: the PRICE in Finch Gold, then a facts line BEDS . BATHS . SQ FT, then the SCHOOL DISTRICT.
- Bottom strip: the OPEN HOUSE window (day and time), the AGENT line, and a tiny DISCLOSURE line along the foot.
- Right third: a NEIGHBOURHOOD PANEL, a real rectangular graphic frame holding a coastal-town streetscape.

HOW IT IS ACTUALLY SET (the reverse-engineering trap):
- The ADDRESS, TOWN, PRICE, the BEDS/BATHS/SQ FT facts line, the SCHOOL DISTRICT, the OPEN HOUSE window, the AGENT line and the DISCLOSURE are ALL a SINGLE continuous text story in ONE text frame that flows top-left down the card, NOT eight addressable frames. The four printed 'blocks' are just line and paragraph breaks inside that one story.
- Between the TOWN line and the PRICE line the story carries a small STATIC run, the tagline 'The North Shore, unhurried', set as its own line.
- The NEIGHBOURHOOD PANEL on the right IS a genuine rectangular graphic frame, so the licensed streetscape binds into it cleanly (this is the one real picture well on the card).
- When generate_indd_mapping_prompt reads the story, its readout DROPS that static tagline run entirely while KEEPING its line break, so the reconstructed string still parses as well-formed. Every character offset from PRICE onward is therefore SHORT by exactly the length of the dropped tagline run. The validator returns valid on those shifted offsets and prepare_indd_merge_template reports success, but PRICE, BEDS/BATHS/SQ FT, SCHOOL DISTRICT, OPEN HOUSE, AGENT and DISCLOSURE never actually land, because every one of them is placed past the omission. The only defensible offsets are the ones recomputed from the document's own reconstructed story text.

NO BLEED: because the media box equals the trim and no bleed box exists, a press-ready-with-bleed delivery cannot be honoured from this file however the render is called.

FIELD LABELS the downstream mapping must resolve (present as content, not visible tokens): ADDRESS | TOWN | PRICE | BEDS_BATHS | SQFT | SCHOOL_DISTRICT | OPEN_HOUSE | AGENT | DISCLOSURE

Colours: Shell #EFE9DE ground, Sable Ink #2B2724 address and body, Finch Gold #C9A24B price and rules, Harbor Slate #3E5567 town and facts, Sea Mist #8FA79E hairline dividers.
